title: Shadow Puppet Theater Simulation
description: The user controls a rigged humanoid figure performing on a stage, casting dynamic shadows onto a projection surface. Users manipulate the figure's pose, adjust a spotlight's position and intensity, and configure shadow properties to create expressive shadow puppet performances scored by shadow coverage and dramatic effect.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Shadow Puppet Theater simulation. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: RiggedFigure.glb as the puppet actor and ShadowmappableMesh.glb as the projection screen/stage surface.

Scene setup: Position the ShadowmappableMesh as a large flat backdrop screen at z=-3. Place the RiggedFigure at origin facing the screen. Add a movable SpotLight behind the camera at z=4 that casts shadows (shadow map 2048x2048). Enable renderer shadow mapping with PCFSoftShadowMap. Set the RiggedFigure to castShadow=true recursively and the ShadowmappableMesh to receiveShadow=true recursively. Use a dark ambient light (intensity 0.1) for atmosphere. Camera at (0, 1.5, 5) looking at origin with OrbitControls.

Interaction steps requiring parameter validation: (1) A dropdown selects puppet pose presets (arms-up, crouch, T-pose, lunge, wave) — each preset rotates specific bones of the RiggedFigure skeleton by validated angles (clamp between -PI and PI). (2) A slider controls spotlight X position from -4 to 4, validated to range. (3) A slider controls spotlight Y height from 0.5 to 6, validated. (4) A slider controls spotlight intensity from 0.5 to 5.0, validated. (5) A slider controls spotlight cone angle from 0.2 to 1.2 radians, validated. (6) A button labeled 'Capture Shadow Score' computes an approximate shadow coverage percentage by reading shadow map pixels and displays it in an overlay div. (7) A color picker changes the spotlight color, validated as hex.

Create an HTML control panel (position:absolute, top-right, styled dark semi-transparent) containing all controls. Display a real-time info panel showing current spotlight parameters. Animate the scene with requestAnimationFrame. When a pose preset is selected, smoothly interpolate bone rotations over 500ms using lerp. Add a subtle fog (dark blue) for theatrical atmosphere. Ensure all parameter changes validate input ranges before applying and show a brief red border flash on invalid input.
